date.as_written: bhuvanaśaragajābjais sammite vikramābde, dinakṛdahani durgāyās thithau rādhaśukle

notes: No historical human individuals are named. Tripuraghna ('destroyer of Tripura') is an epithet of Śiva as mythological author; Gaṇapati, Guru, and Vāṇī are invoked; and 'tribhuvananaranātha' ('lord of the three worlds') is the deity for whose pleasure the copy was made. The chronogram reads bhuvana (3), śara (5), gaja (8), abja (1) = VS 1853. The copyist/patron remains anonymous (subject of alīlikhat).
